discrepancy_pattern.revenue: No day has a revenue difference. Not one in 71.
discrepancy_pattern.cash_scan: Differs on a minority of days, always traceable to how the ice deduction was handled, or to a form whose own figures do not balance. Excel resolves these by deriving scan = revenue - cash, which OCR_RULES 4.1 forbids as an observation.
